name: sprayer_boom
source: A crop sprayer boom. It touches nothing: no draft, no soil force, no depth (kind applicator). It works while switched on over workable ground, moving forward; the width comes from the model's two work sockets, the mass from the vehicle. Rates and tank contents belong to the game.

range.source: [AS] Usual working speeds of a field sprayer 6-12 km/h (manufacturer ranges, not read from a standard); above 12 km/h the boom's drift and height errors cost quality, 0.15 per km/h to a floor of 0.3.
